name: Nouméa La Tontouta International Airport

runway.v: One runway, 11/29, 3,250 m × 45 m, paved, PCN 61.

hours.v: Aerodrome, ATS, fuel and handling H24.
hours.quote: Gestionnaire de l'AD / AD administration H24

customs.v: Police (immigration) H24; customs and biosecurity during the airport's commercial operation (hours not stated).
customs.quote: Police : H24 - TEL : 35 12 19 ... Customs - TEL: 35 11 72, Biosecurity - TEL duty: 77 19 34: during commercial operation of AD

ppr.v: International flights must notify at least 24 hours before expected arrival (stand availability), except urgent flights, preferably by email to the CCI airport operations service and the BRIA.
ppr.quote: international flights: at least 24 hours before their expected arrival, except urgent flights

notes: Read the AIP Nouvelle-Calédonie AD 2 NWWW page from the SIA eAIP of 15 May 2025 (AIRAC 2025-05-15), the only edition found. It is old and may be superseded, so re-check before quoting. No curfew is stated; the noise section is empty. Give 24 h notice for international arrivals. Customs is tied to commercial operating hours, so a late arrival needs checking with the handler.
